review_notes.finding: Skin uses detailed and separately mip-filtered normals for scattering. Eye blends sclera/iris, pupil dilation remaps radial UV; iris normal and gloss are separately controlled.

adoption.mechanism: Separate pixel-filtered microrelief normal for specular and millimetre-filtered relief normal for diffuse correction. Procedural diffuse uses smooth base normal.
adoption.validation: Release build and Metal GPU shader validation passed; three brow poses before/after rendered and viewed. git diff --check passed.
adoption.limits: Artistic 1 mm filter; additional sampling cost unmeasured; procedural fallback not separately visually checked; no new volumetric SSS.

pupil_adoption.mechanism: Piecewise radial annulus remapping for both pigment and relief, with finite centre and fixed limbus. Adjustable pupil_diameter_mm 2..8, default 4.05. Adapted principle, not original power function.
pupil_adoption.validation: Three Metal renders 2/4.05/8 mm viewed; mesh test confirms geometry and non-eye material coordinates remain unchanged; invalid 9 mm rejected.

review_notes.finding: Iris heightmap parallax, separate diffuse normal from specular surface normal, SSS_STRENGTH and direct LIGHT_COLOR/ATTENUATION.
Shape -> joint regression -> pose correction from rotation-minus-identity -> rigid transform and LBS. Correctives precede skinning; data/model licensing separate concern.
